name: Jean Philippe Arthur Dubuffet
style: Impasto technique, thick oil paint mixed with materials such as mud, sand, coal dust, pebbles, pieces of glass, string, straw, plaster, gravel, cement, and tar
theme: Everyday life, people sitting in the Paris Métro or walking in the country
color: Strong, unbroken colors recalling the palette of Fauvism
composition: Individuals placed in a very cramped space
